product_guards: The auditor's protocol-only suggestion does not prove the destination exists. Require coherent observed HTML 200 source and destination, a current source canonical matching the old URL, and an exact HTTP-to-HTTPS upgrade preserving authority, port, path case, query and trailing slash.
Require an indexable, self-canonical or canonical-less destination. Only a self upgrade may retain the source's current HTTP canonical before repair; that value is the defect being repaired.

An observed HTTP target redirecting to or declaring another master contradicts the upgrade and is refused. Missing HTTP-target observations do not invalidate an independently observed exact HTTPS destination.

Bind verified pairs to resolved non-shared source files. Only literal canonical values change; alternate/hreflang, og:url and navigation are preserved. No AI file targeting or generation fallback for unknown, shared or computed sources.

Block URL/GitHub free-form model previews and their confirmation before cached previews, quota or GitHub access, after project authorization. The evidence-bound deep and bulk fixers remain available. Historical receipts, billing records and pending recoveries are not deleted or migrated.
Keep canonical_from_http_to_https as hosting advice and retain all catalog/auditor entries; no scoring rule or catalog key is removed.

successful_live_cycle.increases_explanation: Each new witness is only canonical-http. Its unchanged duplicate title, description and single incoming link become visible to controlled indexable-page scoring when its canonical becomes self-referential. This is not an all-green crawl and none of these other families is repaired by this phase.

independent_countercheck.description: Re-read both closed draft unmerged PRs and exact successful builds, unchanged main and seed, and the one corrective commit affecting only the allowed file. Independently parse saved and fresh HTML canonical tags; compare exact GitHub bytes and served bytes after normalizing only the parsed owned Netlify deployment-id attribute. Recalculate the protocol family from raw and projected observations; validate 49 preserved routes and all three counter increases. Re-prepare the actual pinned baseline using the final guard without any permitted provider, quota or write access.

limitations: This proves the one observed self-upgrade on a static owned fixture, not every stack, shared/computed template, external master, TLS condition or customer site. External known-master support and negative destinations are synthetic tests, not separately rebuilt live sites.

The final HTTP-master contradiction guard was added after the fixture cycle. A fresh read-only countercheck against the final code revalidates the pinned proposal and exact builds. Fixture contents and rewrite bytes are unchanged; the final full suite includes all four added cases.

Native previews remain noindex. Controlled scoring uses the existing exact preview-host/header projection and saved XML; it does not certify production indexing or raw alias/discovery equivalence. The protocol-family witness also changes 1 to 0 in raw observations.

Three existing SEO warnings become visible for the now-canonical page; their text and links were not repaired. Other nonzero counters remain, so no all-green or global score-improvement verdict is made.

No receipt migration, production recovery replay, agent deployment, client onboarding, scheduler, payment workflow, capacity test or new PostgreSQL run is included. SQLite-suite skips remain outside this validation.
